title: Russian Beet Borscht
description: A traditional Russian beet soup, served with a dollop of sour cream. Perfect for a cold day.
instructions: In a large pot, combine the beets, vegetable broth, Russian beet soup mix, sugar, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender or a regular blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Return the pot to the stovetop and add the sour cream. Stir over low heat until the soup is heated through.
Crack the egg into the pot and stir constantly until the egg is fully incorporated and the soup has thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the borscht hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill.
Refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
